Notification of Transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibility and Persons Closely Associated with them

In accordance with Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation, the Company announces that it has been notified of the following transactions in the Company's Ordinary shares undertaken by the following person discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR).
Vesting of award under the Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP)
On 3 September 2026, ordinary shares in Drax Group plc were issued to Paul Sheffield (Chief Commercial Officer) following the automatic vesting of awards originally granted on 3 September 2024.
The Company was notified on 3 September 2026 that Paul Sheffield had elected to sell all shares acquired on the vesting of his LTIP award, as set out in the table below.
Number of shares sold at 783p per share
